digest.component_or_area: Codex Gerrit workflow documentation and testing
propositions: Codex sessions incorrectly treat curl --netrc 401 responses as proof of invalid Gerrit HTTPS credentials when credentials are valid but managed by a git credential helper

AGENTS.md Codex Gerrit workflow rule must document that authenticated /a/ REST polling requires git credential fill when using a Git credential helper, and that curl --netrc is only valid for explicitly configured .netrc files
The documented shell pattern must pass credentials directly to curl without echoing or logging passwords while preserving existing git push and Gerrit gate guidance
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_codex_agent_guidance.py must assert correct use of git credential fill, curl --netrc behavior, false-401 explanation, and password no-echo requirement
